instruction_scene.instruction_one_heading: Instructions for creating a projection hologram
instruction_scene.instruction_one_supply:
4 x A4 acetate paper
1 x A4 paper
1 x scissors
1 x ruler
1 x adhesive tape
instruction_scene.instruction_two:
1. Measure screen diagonal.

2. Draw an equilateral triangle with the side length exactly half of the screen diagonal.

3. Divide two triangle sides into 3-10 of the length
4. Cut drawn trapeze Tape the edges
instruction_scene.instruction_three: Place the screen on the flat surface and put the pyramid on the centre of the screen

welcome_scene.hello_text:
Hello! HoloZoo is an educational game about animals and their endangerment status in nature.

The game uses two Android mobile devices that need to be connected via Bluetooth to display a hologram you can interact with.

Don't worry! If you don't want to use two devices, the hologram will still be displayed on this device.

Learn how to create a pyramidal hologram in the following steps.
